patterns.note: Alternating light and dark background sections are used to visually delineate distinct product categories or content blocks, creating clear segmentation down the page.
A distinctive pixelated/monospace font is strategically applied to specific UI elements, such as the country selector, product labels, and calls-to-action, establishing a unique brand signature.
A predominantly monochromatic base palette of black, white, and various greys is consistently used, allowing the vibrant colors of the product imagery to serve as the primary visual accents.
Product sections reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye through the content.
The page is structured around large, full-width product showcase sections that feature high-quality, often isolated, photography of the products with minimal descriptive text.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes an auto-playing background video to immediately capture attention and set a dynamic, premium tone for the site.
Scroll-triggered animations are employed to reveal subsequent content sections, where elements like product images and text subtly fade or slide into view as the user scrolls down the page.
A distinct pixelated font is integrated into key UI components and calls-to-action, providing a unique brand signature against a clean, modern sans-serif typography system.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are bold and significantly larger than body text, with a distinct pixelated font used for smaller, impactful UI labels and buttons.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, primarily seen on buttons and some card elements, while product imagery often maintains sharp edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and airy presentation of individual product showcases.

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the deliberate and consistent integration of a retro-inspired pixelated font for specific UI elements and calls-to-action, which creates a unique brand voice and a playful contrast against the otherwise sleek, modern product photography and minimalist layout.
